sources.title: habiba277/Toxic-Content-Classification-DistilBERT-LoRA-Llama-Guard - GitHub
sources.snippet: Overview Fine-tunes distilbert-base-uncased on a toxic content classification dataset using LoRA (Low-Rank Adaptation) via the HuggingFace PEFT library. Instead of retraining all 66M parameters, LoRA injects small trainable low-rank matrices into the attention layers (q_lin, v_lin), reducing trainable parameters by over 99%.
